plan: L70 controls, stated before any controls program exists

definitions.contact: method A margin exactly 0; method B intersection nonempty with area exactly 0
definitions.past: 1e-30 beyond contact (a length for translations and sides; a factor 1 - 1e-30 on the centre distance for pair closings)
definitions.closing a pair: square j's centre moved along the centre line to c_i + lambda (c_j - c_i), lambda = T / max_w |w.(c_j - c_i)| over the four edge normals, T = (1 + |u_i.u_j| + |u_i.v_j|)/2: the factor at which the largest projection gap is exactly 0
definitions.whole-file: every square, wall and pair decided by both methods (l70_check.decide)
definitions.wall-level: every square's shape, containment and wall contacts decided by both methods; the pairs are unchanged by construction (a side change or a common translation changes no pair margin and no intersection), and were decided in the check
definitions.pair-level: the two squares alone, decided by both methods
definitions.square-level: the square alone, decided by both methods
definitions.reader: the frozen reader on the mutated bytes

controls.what: the last square replaced by a copy of the first
square 1 translated by (S, 0)
the last row deleted, header unchanged
the header count raised by one
row 1's t token replaced by 1.5
the rotation read the other way: every t negated (each square reflected in its horizontal centre line)

expect.overlapping_pairs: at least one, equal sets by both methods

controls.what: the side lowered by 1/q, one unit of its own last place
the side lowered by its least far-wall clearance c
the side lowered by c + 1e-30
the side set to its 12-place ceiling (the print)
the side set to its 12-place floor
every square moved left by the least left clearance
every square moved left by the least left clearance + 1e-30
every square moved down by the least bottom clearance
every square moved down by the least bottom clearance + 1e-30
the least-margin pair (33, 41) closed along its centre line to contact (square 41 moved)
the pair (33, 41) closed 1e-30 past contact
every pair with margin below 1e-12 closed along its centre line, at contact and 1e-30 past

expect.at_contact: touch by both methods, every pair
expect.past: overlap by both methods, every pair

controls.what: every square moved to its nearest wall by its exact clearance, and 1e-30 past

expect.at_contact: inside with that wall contact by both methods, every square
expect.past: outside by both methods, every square
